solution.title: Peripheral, Driver & Device-Control Management for Enterprise Desktops (Intune)

products.name: Peripheral, Driver & Device-Control Management for Enterprise Desktops (Intune) — Commercial
products.short_description: Manage drivers, peripherals/printers, and removable-device control across enterprise desktops with Intune — safe driver delivery, peripheral connections, and USB policy — pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Control the peripherals, drivers, and USB devices on every desktop

Printers that won't map, a driver that breaks a fleet, and uncontrolled USB storage are daily desktop pain — and a compliance risk in regulated environments. This solution gives you a repeatable way to manage peripherals, drivers, and device control with Intune: deliver and update drivers safely, manage printer and peripheral connections, and control removable/USB devices — deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Intune manages drivers (Windows driver update management), peripherals/printers, and device control (removable-storage access), and the standard deployment model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune enrollment, Entra groups, driver/printer sources, Defender device control prerequisites, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to configure Windows driver update management, deploy printer/peripheral configuration, and set device-control (USB/removable) policy, assign to a named pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — peripheral/driver/device-control discovery, per-device applied-state validation, a driver/peripheral/device-control coverage report, safe remediation of missing/blocked devices, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (driver current, printer mapped, USB policy enforced), plus Best Practices for staged driver rollout and exceptions.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Drivers current, peripherals working, and removable devices controlled across the fleet — managed from Intune, pilot-first, with a repeatable method and scripts you keep and reuse.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PERIDEV-Discovery.ps1 — inventory driver, peripheral/printer, and device-control policies in Intune
    • PERIDEV-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix devices missing or blocked from PERIDEV coverage
    • PERIDEV-Report.ps1 — coverage report across a target group for all three PERIDEV areas
    • PERIDEV-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the PERIDEV pilot and targeting groups
    • PERIDEV-Validation.ps1 — per-device applied state for the three PERIDEV gates

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
